narrative: On the plot. The plot on the peg. The hour under the title. A hand at the peg. No part-slip beside it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played, and brought no part-name away.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: The name is his, from last night. He is not on this plot.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: They had the name by this afternoon.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Shown on plot in Titus, no name of a part
